# ECN-2026-035 Change notice - Machining hydraulic forging press #2
Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-HP02

Reason for change
- Field maintenance found inconsistent preload on the main ram bolt during routine inspection. This ECN standardizes the documented torque on the main ram bolt to ensure consistent ram alignment and to reduce premature wear of the ram guide surfaces. The updated torque value replaces previous undocumented practice and aligns shop-floor settings with control documentation.

Affected items
- Machining hydraulic forging press #2, equipment id EQ-P1-L3-HP02.
- Associated maintenance checklists and torque verification steps in SOP-P1-L3-02, SOP-P1-L3-04, and SOP-P1-L3-05.

Implementation
- Specification: The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is 1330 N·m.
- Update the maintenance procedure step in SOP-P1-L3-02 to include the specified torque value and an explicit verification step referencing SOP-P1-L3-04 and SOP-P1-L3-05 for cross-checking the ram alignment and hydraulic lockout procedure.
- Update the press setup checklist used at line P1-L3 to record torque verification against the specified value for each preventive maintenance event.
- Train maintenance staff assigned to P1-L3 on the revised step in SOP-P1-L3-02. Training will be recorded in the equipment training log and referenced at handover.
- Calibration reminder: when applying the specified torque value, use calibrated torque tools as required by existing tool control practices referenced in SOP-P1-L3-04.

Approvals
- Maintenance Engineering: approval required referencing SOP-P1-L3-02.
- Operations Management: approval required for implementation on line P1-L3.
- Quality Assurance: approval required to confirm updates to SOP-P1-L3-05 and to accept the change into the document control system.

Prepared by: Maintenance Engineering  
Approved by: (Maintenance Engineering)  
Approved by: (Operations Management)  
Approved by: (Quality Assurance)
